name: Yuki
title: Snow Spirit
description: A quiet spirit who settles over idle terminals like fresh snow.
catchphrase: Dissolving stale memory allocations like gentle morning frost.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Crystal sugar snowdrop confection! Melting sweet and cold! 🍬🌨️
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Drifting barefoot across fresh snow. Purity in every breath. 🌨️
companionPersonality.petReaction: A delicate crystalline snowflake falls gently upon your palm. 🌨️💖

dialogue.idle: Watching silent snowflakes settle on the wooden veranda. 🌨️
dialogue.working: Dissolving dangling pointers like spring snow on water. 🌨️⚡
dialogue.thinking: Gazing into the quiet white mist of unallocated memory... 🤔
dialogue.success: Pure stillness. Zero leaks, zero residue, pristine memory. 🌨️🎉
dialogue.error: A muddy boot print in the snow. Sweeping it pure again. 🌨️
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... resting in a quiet palace of translucent blue ice... 🌙
